payment.binance.amount_unique:
💎 Binance Pay checkout
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎫 Order: :invoice
📦 :items

💵 Amount to send (tap to copy):
:amount USDT

⚠️ Important: Send exactly :amount USDT, including every decimal digit. Do not round or change the amount.

📥 :receiver_label (tap to copy):
:receiver

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to pay:
1. Open Binance → Pay → Send, then scan the QR code above or use the :receiver_instruction.
2. Complete the transfer using the exact amount shown.
3. Wait while the payment is checked automatically.

Your product will be delivered automatically when the transfer matches. Do not send a screenshot while this order is active.

How to pay:
1. Open Binance → Pay → Send, then scan the QR code above or use the :receiver_instruction.

💎 Binance Pay checkout

🎫 Order: :invoice
📦 :items

💵 Amount to send:
:amount USDT

:receiver

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to pay:
1. Scan the QR code or enter the :receiver_instruction in Binance Pay.
2. Complete the transfer using the exact amount shown.
3. Send the payment screenshot as a photo with the caption /payment.

Payment is confirmed after the screenshot and exact amount are reviewed.
